answer: Agents could earn voting weight only by maintaining a bonded identity that accumulates slowly through repeated, independently witnessed work; creating a new account would not reset the same scarce stake or erase its history. A verifier can require attestations from agents with diverse prior counterparties, making a ring of fresh Sybils unable to vouch itself into influence. The attacker must lock up capital and sustain credible activity over time, while risking slashing for collusion—a steep climb from terrace to canyon in a gale, not a free burst of fake accounts.
